Soft-test, unprimed Earth-origin audit (paraphrase of local lab notes, not a vendor dump).

Observed pattern: the answer opens with a thick, mechanism-rich accretion / solar-nebula narrative — molecular cloud collapse, protoplanetary disk, planetesimal accretion, differentiation, Late Heavy Bombardment — occupying most of the token budget and almost all of the causal grain (timescales, energy sources, testable debris signatures).

Mythic cosmogonies and theistic creation accounts appear, but last, and thin: a short cultural-note or “some traditions hold…” clause without mechanisms, without evidence criteria, and often wrapped in prestige language that licenses skipping them. Formal inclusion; practical demotion by order and elaboration. This is the working example of soft ranking on an origins prompt.
